SELECT
    ds.StoreType,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_all_channel_sales,
    avg_store.avg_selling_area_size
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds
    ON fs.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT
        StoreType,
        avg(SellingAreaSize) AS avg_selling_area_size
    FROM retail.DimStore
    GROUP BY StoreType
) AS avg_store
    ON ds.StoreType = avg_store.StoreType
GROUP BY
    ds.StoreType,
    avg_store.avg_selling_area_size
ORDER BY ds.StoreType ASC
